en: Dvigocchaka, Kusalattika (The Group of Twos, Wholesome Triplet)

Dependent on a state that is not associated with clinging (*noupādāna*) and is wholesome (*kusala*), a state that is not associated with clinging and is unwholesome (*nakusala*) arises by way of the root condition (*hetupaccaya*). Under the root condition: one [formula] … pe … under the non-disappearance condition: one.

Dependent on a state that is associated with clinging (*upādāna*) and is unwholesome, a state that is not associated with clinging and is neither-unwholesome-nor-wholesome arises by way of the root condition. … Under the root condition: three … pe … under the non-disappearance condition: three.

Dependent on a state that is not defiled (*nokilesa*) and is wholesome, a state that is not defiled and is neither-wholesome-nor-unwholesome arises by way of the root condition. Under the root condition: one … pe … under the non-disappearance condition: three. (Abbreviated.)
